results.text:
I picked up this Pioneer 65" 4K UHD Smart Roku TV (PN65-R851-26U) on sale at Best Buy, and it's been an awesome addition to my living room. The picture quality is surprisingly vibrant with HDR10 support—colors pop, and 4K content looks sharp and detailed. Setup was a breeze thanks to the simple Roku interface; I was streaming in minutes.

I love how easy it is to access all my favorite apps like Netflix, Disney+, and Hulu, plus tons of free channels and shows through Roku. The voice remote works great with Alexa and Google Assistant (and even Siri shortcuts), making searches hands-free. Game Mode is a nice bonus for console gaming with low lag.

For the price, this is fantastic value—huge screen without breaking the bank. Sound is decent too with Dolby Audio. Highly recommend if you're looking for affordable big-screen entertainment! 5 stars.
results.title: Great Budget Big-Screen TV!

results.text: I had purchased this TV 8 days ago. It just fit into my 2024 Hyundai Kona. I had to adjust my front seats closer to the steering wheel than my normal driving position. I carried it into the house by myself, however, it would have been a lot easier with another person. The picture quality is really good. It's internal speaker's sound quality is superb. But even better through my Onn Soundbar. The price for this TV is ridiculousally low compared with other TVs of the same size and quality. I am very happy with my purchase and do recommend this absolute bargain to anyone considering a new TV who can not afford an OLED TV.
results.title: Pioneer 65"  UHD Roku TV
